messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Stan 2.6.2 and CmdStan 2.6.2
parts:
We've publicly released Stan and CmdStan versions 2.6.2.
As usual, check out the home page for download instructions:

http://mc-stan.org/


BUG FIX RELEASE
---------------
This is a two-for-one special release because version 2.6.1
was never announced. Only the patch version was incremented (from
2.6.0 to 2.6.2), indicating there are no new features in
this release and that it remains backward-compatible with
older releases.

NEW DEVELOPERS
--------------
We've added three new developers to the core dev team,
Brian Lau (MatlabStan), Rob Goedman (Stan.jl), and Jonah
Sol Gabry (ShinyStan).

CRAN
----
The main motivation was to fix some outstanding bugs and
allow compilation without the C++11 long long type and to fix
an issue with the non-standard __float128 type from g++ 4.9.
This was the last obstacle blocking RStan from being released
through CRAN.

BETTER PARSER ERROR MESSAGES
----------------------------
Although it didn't make it into the release notes, one thing you
may notice is that the parser for Stan programs should be returning
much more informative errors for syntactic errors in Stan programs.

OTHER BUG FIXES
---------------
Other outstanding issues fixed include properly rejecting
in normal CDFs when they hit a NaN arithmetically, which should
prevent Stan from terminating without samples in some situations.
We also fixed issue with append_row/_col return types, an
issue with indexing in the ODE solver, and an issue related
to double-indexing of matrices which caused errors to be raised
when values should have been returned.

The manual's also been updated to fix all the typos and brainos
we know of.

MAJOR REFACTORING OF MATH LIB
-----------------------------
There was also a huge amount of tidying up of directory and
include structure under the hood in the C++ API that is not
user facing, but should help us with longer-term maintenance.

Full release notes below, and we'll announce here again and
on Andrew's blog when RStan and PyStan have released 2.6.2.

- Stan Dev Team


v2.6.2 (14 March 2015)
======================================================================

Bug Fixes
----------------------------------------
* fixed append_row and append_col to return the corect types [#1297]
* documentation fix: fixed generation of stan-functions.txt [#1327]
* changed constructor of stan::agrad::var so it can compile without
C++11 [#1337, 1364]
* fixed bug in matrix double-indexing [#1342]
* fixed calculation of derivative in normal_cdf_log, normal_ccdf_log
[#1357]

API Enhancements
----------------------------------------
* refactored math / autodiff library [#1222, #1349, #1353]
* fixed capitalization in tests [#1355]
* updated Eigen to 3.2.4 [#1173]



v2.6.1 (3 March 2015)
======================================================================

Language Enhancements
----------------------------------------
* improved warning messages from the parser [#1244]

API/Build/Test Enhancements
----------------------------------------
* the C++ API now throws 3 types of exceptions [#685]
* parts of the C++ API were rearranged (gm, common) [#942]
* replace promote_args
* allow reading from a local makefile outside of the code repository [#1277]
* added gradient of hessian functional in C++ [#1272]
* supressed printing of adjoints when printing stan::agrad::var [#330]
* removed some cpplint warnings [#1282]
* removed doxygen warnings [#1290]
* reimplemented fmix and fmax [#1311]

Bug Fixes
----------------------------------------
* allow nested indexes to compile with integrate_ode [#1317]

Documentation
----------------------------------------
* fixed typos in MCMC sampling
